system_texts: ME and ID will work on the smartboard to design something during the next thirty minutes.
ME and ID will perform the evaluation of the product after the design session.
gold_texts: The industrial designer and user interface designer will jointly develop the prototype on the SMARTboard. They were allocated a thirty-minute work period; sketching began in the recorded meeting.
The marketing expert will prepare a product-evaluation procedure/presentation; the project manager clarified that the product need not be evaluated yet.
